blocks.tamil_translation: (AS) was sitting near the Prophet ﷺ when a creaking sound was heard from the sky. He raised his head and said, “Just now a door of the heaven has been opened. That door was never opened before this. An angel came down from it. He had never come down to the earth before this.' That angel came into the presence of the Prophet ﷺ, gave salam and said, “Receive the good news that you have been given two lights that were not given to any Prophet. One is Surah al-Fatihah, and the other is the last two ayahs of Surah al-Baqarah. Whatever you recite from these, it will be granted to you.”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- That is, if it is a phrase of praise, the reward of praising will be received; if it is a phrase of du'a, the du'a will be accepted.
(Sharh at-Tibi)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيْرٍ ﵄ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: اِنَّ اللهَ كَتَبَ كِتَاباً قَبْلَ اَنْ يَخْلُقَ السَّموَاتِ وَاْلاَرْضَ بِاَلْفَيْ عَامٍ اَنْزَلَ مِنْهُ آيَتَيْنِ. خَتَمَ بِهِمَا سُوْرَةَ الْبَقَرَةِ وَلَا يُقْرَآنِ فِيْ دَارٍ ثَلَاثَ لَيَالٍ فَيَقْرَبُهَا شَيْطَانٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن غريب باب ما جاء في اخر سورة البقرة رقم:٢٨٨٢
blocks.tamil_translation: “Two thousand years before creating the heavens and the earth, Allah wrote a book. From that book He sent down two ayahs. With them Allah has concluded “Surah al-Baqarah”. In whichever house these two ayahs are recited for three nights in a row, Shaytan will not even come near that house.” Hazrat Nu'man ibn Bashir (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ مَسْعُوْدِنِ اْلاَنْصَارِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ قَرَأَ اْلآيَتَيْنِ مِنْ آخِرِ سُوْرَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ فِيْ لَيْلَةٍ كَفَتَاهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن صحيح باب ما جاء في اخر سورة البقرة رقم:٢٨٨١
